# Pedro Sant'Anna's Claude Code Workflow

license: `MIT` · 44 skills · last update: 2026-04-27

**Source:** <https://github.com/pedrohcgs/claude-code-my-workflow>

**Maintainers:** Pedro H. C. Sant'Anna (Emory University, Economics)

**Compatibility:** `claude-code`

> A ready-to-fork Claude Code template for academics using LaTeX/Beamer + R. 30 skills + 14 agents. 1,112 stars. Calibrated peer-review pipeline against AER, QJE, JPE, Econometrica, ReStud. Adopted by 15+ research groups.
